items.title: Police say group of IS-linked women not charged upon return to Australia
items.description: Two flights carrying women and children linked to the Islamic State group have landed in Australia.

items.title: 'Very scary and sad': Travellers in limbo after company enters liquidation
items.description: An Australian travel company selling heavily discounted international holidays has collapsed, leaving customers scrambling and their plans in disarray.

items.title: Navy chief says Chinese flotilla in Tasman Sea had 'impact'
items.description: Australia's Chief of Navy says China stirred "anger" in New Zealand when it sent a powerful naval flotilla into the Tasman Sea last year, encouraging political support on both sides of the ditch for increased defence spending.

items.title: CBA boss says reconsider applying CGT change to non-passive assets
items.description: The Commonwealth Bank boss speaks out about the government's tax changes.

items.title: Iron ore processing project dumped by BHP for not being profitable enough
items.description: Internal BHP documents reveal how the mining giant planned to set up an iron ore processing facility in the Pilbara to cut carbon emissions before backing away from it entirely.

items.title: US military strikes Iranian boats and missile launch sites
items.description: US Centcom says the strikes were designed "to protect our troops from threats posed by Iranian forces".

items.title: One woman will make Japanese history by going on maternity leave
items.description: A Japanese mayor will take maternity leave this year, becoming the first in the country's history to do so while in office.

items.title: Bondi gunman remained on counter-terror radar in 2022
items.description: Naveed Akram and his father travelled to Uzbekistan around 2022 and a former terror hotspot in the Philippines shortly before committing the Bondi massacre.

items.title: Archibald Prize sitter calls out APY art collective mistreatment
items.description: Award-winning artist Iluwanti Ken says the withdrawal of funding and support over the "white hands on black art" scandal has left her feeling like a stranger in her own industry.

items.title: Four dead, including two children, after train hits Belgian school bus
items.description: The train collided with a minibus, which was carrying nine people at the time, at a level crossing.

items.title: NACC boss Paul Brereton admits he contributed to own 'downfall'
items.description: The corruption watchdog boss, appearing during a tense grilling at Senate estimates, admits his conduct became a "distraction".

items.title: K-pop triumphs at American Music Awards as Pussycat Dolls lead noughties nostalgia
items.description: Taylor Swift led the night with eight nominations but didn't take home a single award, while 80s rock star Billy Idol was honoured with a Lifetime Achievement Award.

items.title: Hypersonic missile attack a sign of Putin's 'bruised ego', expert says
items.description: Russia escalates attacks on Kyiv by using a hypersonic missile in one of its largest assaults on the Ukrainian capital since the start of the four-year war, and warns foreigners to leave the city ahead of further strikes.

items.title: Romanian man jailed for stealing from elderly Australian shoppers
items.description: The Romanian citizen, who illegally visited Australia as part of a global "distraction fraud" operation, has been jailed after fleecing thousands of dollars from elderly Australian shoppers.

items.title: When moving forward means being the cycle-breaker in a family
items.description: Motherhood has a way of making family patterns impossible to ignore. Suddenly you start asking questions you never asked before.

items.title: Using AI to manage your budget? This is what experts want you to know
items.description: "Hallucinations", privacy and other factors to consider if you're turning to artificial intelligence for financial advice.

items.title: The many phases of Miles Davis, who would have turned 100 today
items.description: From Illinois to New York to Australia, legendary trumpeter Miles Davis helped shape the direction of jazz with albums like Birth of the Cool and Kind of Blue.

items.title: Police taskforce investigating Dezi Freeman arrests two men
items.description: Detectives investigating the movements of police killer Dezi Freeman have arrested two men in Victoria's north-east.

items.title: After losing her 3yo daughter, one mum says MDMA therapy saved her life
items.description: Jess Yugovich is among the Australians trying MDMA-assisted psychotherapy after being diagnosed with PTSD, as highly regulated facilities process the drug for therapeutic use.

items.title: Teary council officer tells ICAC they 'should be ashamed of yourselves'
items.description: Roxanne Thornton accuses Independent Commission Against Corruption of "laying the boot in" after four days of questioning over the manipulation of the recruitment process at the council to secure jobs for friends and associates.

items.title: Police officer accused of rape denied he was 'sleazy', court told
items.description: A police officer goes on trial in South Australia's District Court after pleading not guilty to two counts of rape and one count of attempted rape.

items.title: Kumanjayi White family 'heartbroken' no charges laid over custody death
items.description: The family of Kumanjayi White tell the ABC they are "heartbroken" that no charges will be laid over his death in custody, as Northern Territory Police confirm their criminal investigation has been concluded.

items.title: Man discovers Stolen Generations truth after decades believing he was adopted
items.description: Ricky Hampson spent most of his life believing he had been adopted before learning several years ago he is a survivor of the Stolen Generations. Today, he is calling for more action and truth-telling.

items.title: Power price drops for most customers as batteries flatten peak
items.description: Surging levels of renewable energy and better reliability from coal-fired generators are set to give consumers a break, with benchmark power prices to fall up to 10 per cent for consumers and more for small businesses.

items.title: Flights resume at training school after two killed in plane crash
items.description: An aviation school resumes flight operations at Adelaide's Parafield Airport four weeks after an instructor and a student onboard a twin-engine plane were killed when it crashed into a hangar.
